sections.description:
Short titile and commencement

THE SINDH CIVIL SERVANTS (REGULARIZATION OF ADHOC APPOINTMENTS)
(AMENDMENT) BILL, 2014
THE SINDH CIVIL
SERVANTS (REGULARIZATION OF ADHOC APPOINTMENTS)
(AMENDMENT) BILL, 2014
SINDH
ACT NO. XII OF 2014
KARACHI,
THE 28TH MARCH, 2014
AN
ACT
NO.PAS/Legis-PB-07/2014---The
Sindh Civil Servants (Regularization of Adhoc Appointments) (Amendment) Bill, 2014 having been
passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 28th
February, 2014 and assented to by the Governor of Sindh
on 27th March, 2013 is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh. to amend the Sindh Civil Servants (Regularization of Adhoc
Appointment) Act, 1994.
Preamble.-
WHEREAS it is expedient to amend the Sindh Civil
Servants (Regularization of Adhoc Appointment)
Act,1994, in the manner hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby
enacted as follows:-
1. Short title and commencement.--
Short titile and
commencement---(1) This Act
may be called the Sindh Civil Servants
(Regularization of Adhoc Appointments) (Amendment)
Act, 2014.
(2) It shall come into force at once and shall be deemed to have
taken effect on and from 28th July, 1994.
